The antinode amplitude from [](`~dohl.ebp.ymax`) for every wind and damping
method accepted by the solver, at three tensions. With the `olla` wind power
the amplitude jumps at low frequency; `cigre` and `foti` (identical without
turbulence) give realistic results with every damping method.
